title: London stock exchange beats Wall Street with best FTSE 100 year since 2009
summary: FTSE index closes up 21.5% on New Year’s Eve at end of strong year for global equity markets How the FTSE 100 ‘dinosaur’ roared back to life Britain’s stock market has increased in value by a fifth over 2025 – its biggest annual gain since 2009 – in a strong year for shares around the world. The FTSE 100 index of blue-chip stocks closed up 21.5% on New Year’s Eve compared with the start of January, beating Wall Street returns. The wider all-share market was 19.75% higher.
